### Tier List Standing & Build Recommendation

- **Tier / Rating on the Community AM5 VRM Sheet:**
  - **Listing (Row 404):** Mini-ITX form factor with a 10-phase "True Phase" VRM layout using 70A Infineon TDA21570 power stages.
  - **Rating:**
    - **"✔ — Runs without issues"** across all standard 65W–120W processors, including mainstream Zen 4/Zen 5 gaming and X3D chips (Ryzen 5 7600/7600X, Ryzen 7 7700/7700X, **Ryzen 7 7800X3D**, **Ryzen 7 9800X3D**, and 12/16-core X3D models like 7900/7900X3D/7950X3D/9950X3D).
    - **"✱ — Mild airflow recommended"** only under full-load stock 170W+ flagships (7900X, 7950X, 9900X, 9950X).
    - **"✱✱ — Strong airflow recommended"** strictly when applying heavy manual overclocks to 16-core flagships.
    - It is never marked as inadequate or unsafe.

- **Verdict for your SFF Build:**
  The ASUS ROG Strix B650E-I Gaming WiFi remains **an outstanding, sensible pick** for a premium Mini-ITX AM5 build. Its 10-phase 70A VRM handles gaming-focused processors like the 7800X3D or 9800X3D effortlessly without thermal throttling. It also delivers future-proof PCIe 5.0 on both the primary x16 GPU slot and M.2 NVMe slot, standard DDR5 support, and strong rear I/O connectivity.
  
  Pairing it with the **Thermalright Peerless Assassin 120 SE** offers top-class cooling performance at a budget-friendly price point, easily keeping your CPU cool and quiet. Just be sure to verify that your chosen SFF chassis has sufficient cooler height clearance (~155 mm) to accommodate the dual-tower design.
